opening.argument: The video makes membership or investment the central route to growing Bitcoin, stating that “The greatest benefit you can get from MtiTI is by becoming a member or investor.” It presents a historical daily return of 0.5834% and explains that “your daily profit is added to your trading pool,” encouraging additional deposits through automatic compounding. It also promotes an affiliate opportunity: qualification requires introducing investors in two separate legs, while the program promises “additional weekly residual income.” Referral and binary profit-sharing bonuses are tied to recruiting investors and maintaining a personal investment of at least $200. The historical-results disclaimer qualifies the return figure, and the available evidence does not establish whether the advertised trading, withdrawals, bonuses, or linked destination produced those outcomes.
